title: Introducing v6
reported_observation: Suno's official release notes describe v6, v6-wild and v6-mini, including plain-language section editing, multi-source mashups, sampling/isolation, and creation using text, audio, images and video.
creator_interpretation: The public interface now supports several task modes beyond a simple one-shot text-to-song prompt. Future experiments must log task and reference modality.
our_hypothesis: Prompt effects may differ by task pathway and input modality; these should be isolated instead of treating all generations as the same experimental regime.
limitations: Research capture summary, not a full audit of the source.
